clips.title: The story
paras: Spirit Rise gathers Thunder Bluff’s spiritual and shamanic study on its northwest mesa. The Skychaser tribe guides seekers above the Pools of Vision, where seers look into spirit-touched waters.

Spirit Rise crowns Thunder Bluff above the plains of Mulgore, devoted to communion with the elements and ancestor spirits. Rope bridges link it to the central mesa. The Hall of Spirits and the Spiritual Healing pavilion draw young and veteran shaman seeking a deeper bond with earth, air, fire, and water. The Skychaser tribe keeps a strong presence across the rise and guides seekers in ancient traditions.
Beneath the open-air totem shrines and huts, an entrance leads into the mesa. The steamy Pools of Vision fill a sacred cavern below, where seers peer into waters touched by the spirits.
